answer.covered_persons: All Executive Officers (current and former) who received Incentive-based Compensation, and all employees (including Executive Officers) and directors (employee and non-employee) who engage in misconduct.

All Executive Officers (current and former) who received Incentive-based Compensation, and all employees (including Executive Officers) and directors (employee and non-employee) who engage in misconduct.

Current or former executive officers, including the president, principal financial officer, principal accounting officer (or controller), vice-presidents in charge of principal business units/divisions/functions, and any other officers or persons performing policy-making functions.

Current and former Executive Officers, defined as individuals designated as officers under Rule 16a-1(f) of the Exchange Act (including those identified in Item 401(b) of Regulation S-K or Item 6.A of Form 20-F), as well as the principal financial officer and principal accounting officer (or controller).

Section 16 Officers (current or former executive officers) for mandatory recovery of erroneously awarded compensation; and Covered Executives (Section 16 Officers plus other senior executives designated by the Committee or Board) for discretionary recovery of recoverable amounts in cases of misconduct, restatement due to misconduct, breach of restrictive covenants, or unearned compensation.

All current and former executive officers (as defined under Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934) and key managers (employees at grade level 32 or above) who served in such capacities during the applicable recovery period or performance period.
Persons who served as an Executive Officer at any time during the performance period for the applicable Incentive-Based Compensation.
Current and former Executive Officers, and any employee of the Company or its affiliates who may be covered by the Incentive Payment Rule.
